build_notes:
^xFFFF77Pros:^7
    Elemental Versatility: The Lightning Arrow Deadeye excels in handling fire, lightning, and cold damage, adapting to various enemy resistances.
    Tri-Elemental Synergy: Trinity gem stacking enhances elemental damage against all foes, boosting single-target and area damage.
    Mastery Advantage: Mastery grants a 25% chance to bypass resistances, increasing damage against tough enemies.
    Speed and Agility: Gathering Winds' mobility and attack speed aid quick progression.
    Precise Strikes: Far Shot rewards positioning, offering up to 60% more damage when farther from enemies.
    Efficient Clearing: Endless Munition adds projectiles to both skills, ensuring effective clearing and focused damage.
    Curse and Defense Boost: Focal Point enhances Sniper's Mark, boosting damage and reducing taken damage.
    Evasion Strategy: Evasion paired with mobility allows for avoiding incoming damage.
    Versatile Tactics: Shifting between Elemental Hit and Artillery Ballista suits various encounters.

^xFFFF77Cons:^7
    Accuracy Challenge: High hit accuracy is crucial, demanding proper gear and investment.
    Vulnerability: The reliance on evasion can lead to vulnerability against strong bursts or groups of foes.
    Gear Demands: Optimal gear with specific stats is needed, potentially requiring time and resources.
    Elemental Balancing: Maintaining resistances and elemental avoidance can be complex and punishing.
    Defensive Limits: Evasion might not match other defense mechanisms in high-damage situations.
    Choice Trade-offs: Precise Technique can impact damage or life balance.
    Complexity Barrier: Not ideal for new players due to intricate mechanics and positioning.
    Boss Challenges: While having solid single-target damage, struggles may persist against toughest bosses.
    Meta Vulnerability: Future updates could affect build effectiveness.

^x70FF70More PoE 3.22 Builds^7: https://loltank.com/poe-builds
^x70FF70For Poe Currency:^7 https://loltank.com/poe-currency
